ordered_diagnoses: Primary CNS Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma
Intravascular Large B-Cell Lymphoma with CNS involvement

s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Dysarthria and slurred speech present
Gait instability present
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter
No contrast enhancement on T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ lymphoma cells
Cerebrospinal fluid presence of lymphoma cells
Bone marrow negative for lymphoma cells

shortlist.label: Intravascular Large B-Cell Lymphoma with CNS involvement
shortlist.why_kept: Brain biopsy findings and presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid, with CNS involvement

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and brain biopsy, along with the brain MRI showing hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, strongly supports this diagnosis. The lack of systemic involvement, as indicated by a negative bone marrow test, also points towards a primary CNS lymphoma.

rejected.label: Intravascular Large B-Cell Lymphoma
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with systemic symptoms and is less likely to have a negative bone marrow test, and the brain MRI findings do not specifically suggest intravascular lymphoma.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: While this condition involves lymphoma cells in the nervous system, the brain biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid findings are more consistent with a primary CNS lymphoma.

rejected.label: Primary CNS Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotype of the lymphoma cells, including CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+, does not specifically suggest anaplastic large cell lymphoma, which typically has a different immunophenotypic profile.

rejected.label: Intravascular Large B-Cell Lymphoma with CNS involvement
rejected.why: Similar to intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, this condition would likely have systemic involvement and a positive bone marrow test, which is not consistent with the patient's presentation.
